name: com.graves.core
description: A native C# framework for defining entities and items as ScriptableObjects, authored through a single editor window, and extended by plugins. The core owns identity, structure, extension and integrity. Plugins own behaviour and presentation. Nothing here defines 2D or 3D, a controller, a movement model, or physical interaction.

samples.description: Seven plugins chosen as shapes worth copying, dependency-closed so they compile together: a plugin with no dependencies at all, data-and-behaviour, a bridge joining two plugins, a collection, and a cross-plugin with an optional half.
How to adopt a proven tool without rewriting it: the tool keeps its own assembly, a third assembly joins it to the framework. Does not compile until you point it at your own tool.
